reports.title: CENTENE CORPORATION REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: The Company is updating its 2026 GAAP diluted EPS guidance floor to greater than $3.46 and its 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance floor to greater than $5.20. Additionally, the Company is decreasing its HBR guidance range to 90.4% to 91.1% and its interest expense guidance range to $600 million to $620 million.
The Company's annual guidance for 2026 is as follows and will be discussed further on our conference call:

GAAP diluted EPS | > $3.46
Adjusted diluted EPS (1) | > $5.20
(1) | A full reconciliation of adjusted diluted EPS is shown in the Non-GAAP Financial Presentation section of this release.
Low | High
Total revenues (in billions) | 196.5 | 200.5
Premium and service revenues (in billions) | 173.0 | 177.0
HBR | 90.4 | 91.1
SG&A expense ratio | 7.2 | 7.8
Adjusted SG&A expense ratio (2) | 6.9 | 7.5
Effective tax rate | 26.5 | 27.5
Adjusted effective tax rate (3) | 25.5 | 26.5
Diluted shares outstanding (in millions) | 497.0 | 500.0
(2) | Adjusted SG&A expense ratio excludes severance costs due to enterprise optimization and contract exits of approximately $355 million to $405 million, enterprise optimization third-party vendor costs of approximately $85 million to $115 million and acquisition and divestiture related expenses of approximately $1 million.
(3) | Adjusted effective tax rate excludes income tax effects of adjustments of approximately $266 million to $270 million.
